summary: Shreya Acquisition Group filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separate the units into Class A ordinary shares, warrants, and rights on or about May 22, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share, and one right entitling the holder to receive one-fourth of one Class A ordinary share upon an initial business combination. Separated securities will trade on the NYSE under symbols SAGU, SAGU WS, and SAGU RT. Holders must contact the transfer agent Continental Stock Transfer Trust to effect separation. This is a routine SPAC unit separation announcement, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are present.
